ride.name: Ride
ride.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Handle Animal gives +2 on Ride checks.

actions.name: Guide Mount with Knees
actions.description: Steer your horse or warbeast using only your legs, keeping both hands free for bows or shields.

actions.name: Stay in Saddle When Hit or Rearing
actions.description: Prevent being thrown or unseated when your mount takes lethal damage or rears in fright.

actions.name: Fast Mount or Dismount
actions.description: Vault onto or off your steed as a free action instead of spending a move action.
